edges.reason: onlyOwner modifier compares owner() with the untrusted msg.sender before toggling the sale flag.
onlyOwner modifier compares owner() with the untrusted msg.sender before toggling the presale flag.
onlyOwner modifier restricts whitelist editing to the msg.sender-equal owner.
onlyOwner modifier restricts whitelist removal to the msg.sender-equal owner.
onlyOwner modifier gates the withdrawal to the msg.sender-equal owner.
onlyOwner modifier gates reserveBaddies to the msg.sender-equal owner.
onlyOwner modifier gates the randomness-based index setting to the owner.
onlyOwner modifier gates provenance setting to the owner.
onlyOwner modifier gates base URI setting to the owner.
Untrusted msg.sender is the direct recipient of the full contract balance via transfer, enabling state-dependent reentry paths.
Untrusted msg.sender is passed as the mint recipient to _safeMint in mintBaddies.
Untrusted msg.sender indexes PRESALER_LIST/PRESALE_PURCHASES and is the mint recipient in presaleMint.
Untrusted msg.sender is the reserved-token recipient in reserveBaddies.
flipSaleState negates SALE_ACTIVE.
flipPresaleState negates PRESALE_ACTIVE.
addToPresaleList writes true into PRESALER_LIST for each entry.
removeFromPresaleList writes false into PRESALER_LIST for each entry.
isPresaler reads PRESALER_LIST[addr].
presalePurchasedCount reads PRESALE_PURCHASES[addr].
withdraw performs the external balance transfer represented by the unsafe operation.
reserveBaddies requires totalSupply + NUM_TO_RESERVE <= MAX_SUPPLY.
reserveBaddies loops NUM_TO_RESERVE times minting reserved tokens.
mintBaddies requires SALE_ACTIVE to be true.
mintBaddies enforces numberOfTokens <= MAX_PURCHASE.
mintBaddies enforces supply.add(numberOfTokens) <= MAX_SUPPLY via SafeMath.
mintBaddies requires BADDIE_PRICE.mul(numberOfTokens) <= msg.value.
presaleMint requires PRESALE_ACTIVE to be true.
presaleMint requires PRESALER_LIST[msg.sender] to be true.
presaleMint enforces PRESALE_MINTED + numberOfTokens <= MAX_PRESALE.
presaleMint enforces PRESALE_PURCHASES[msg.sender] + numberOfTokens <= MAX_PRESALE_PURCHASE.
presaleMint requires BADDIE_PRICE.mul(numberOfTokens) <= msg.value.
presaleMint enforces supply.add(numberOfTokens) <= MAX_SUPPLY.
setStartingIndex reduces the blockhash value modulo MAX_SUPPLY.
setStartingIndex computes the index from blockhash(block.number - 1).
The blockhash-derived value is stored into STARTING_INDEX.
setProvenanceHash overwrites PROVENANCE.
tokenURI reads STARTING_INDEX to decide shuffling and early return.
tokenURI reduces the shuffled id modulo MAX_SUPPLY.
tokenURI performs the unchecked addition tokenId + STARTING_INDEX.
Unchecked use of STARTING_INDEX in (tokenId + STARTING_INDEX) can overflow/wrap with attacker-controlled tokenId.
presaleMint executes the unchecked addition PRESALE_MINTED + numberOfTokens and the ++ increment.
Unchecked reads/writes of PRESALE_MINTED in presaleMint can wrap on overflow under pragma ^0.6.6.
presaleMint executes the unchecked addition PRESALE_PURCHASES[msg.sender] + numberOfTokens and the ++ increment.
Unchecked reads/writes of PRESALE_PURCHASES[msg.sender] in presaleMint can wrap on overflow.
reserveBaddies mints through _safeMint, which calls _checkOnERC721Received.
mintBaddies mints through _safeMint, which calls _checkOnERC721Received.
presaleMint mints through _safeMint, which calls _checkOnERC721Received.
_checkOnERC721Received invokes the recipient's onERC721Received when the target is a contract.
A malicious recipient contract can re-enter reserveBaddies from the onERC721Received callback.
A malicious recipient contract can re-enter mintBaddies during the _safeMint callback.
A malicious recipient contract can re-enter presaleMint during the _safeMint callback.
Caller-controlled numberOfTokens bounds the mint loop and the supply/price checks in mintBaddies.
Local supply snapshot seeds the token ids minted in mintBaddies.
Caller-controlled numberOfTokens drives the presale allocation and mint loop.
Local supply snapshot seeds the token ids minted in presaleMint.
Local balance is read and forwarded in the withdraw transfer.
Owner-supplied entries array drives the addToPresaleList loop.
Loop-local entry address is written into PRESALER_LIST.
Loop counter controls iteration over entries in addToPresaleList.
Owner-supplied entries array drives the removeFromPresaleList loop.
Loop-local entry address is cleared in PRESALER_LIST.
Loop counter controls iteration over entries in removeFromPresaleList.
provenanceHash parameter is assigned to PROVENANCE.
baseURI parameter is forwarded to _setBaseURI.
tokenId parameter feeds existence checks and the shuffled id computation.
Local id is concatenated into the returned URI in tokenURI.
addr parameter indexes PRESALER_LIST in isPresaler.
addr parameter indexes PRESALE_PURCHASES in presalePurchasedCount.
Local supply snapshot seeds the reserved token ids in reserveBaddies.
Loop counter controls iteration over NUM_TO_RESERVE in reserveBaddies.
